description: This bar chart, from the paper “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models,” illustrates the effect sizes for four different model configurations—mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute—across nine language families or groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the “effect” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the language groups in alphabetical order. Each group contains four stacked bars, each representing one model configuration: mBERT-targ (light blue), XLM-targ (dark blue), mBERT-permute (light green), and XLM-permute (dark green). Error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability. The approximate values for the bars are as follows: for IE-Baltic, mBERT-targ is ~22, XLM-targ is ~16, mBERT-permute is ~6, and XLM-permute is ~5; for IE-Germanic, mBERT-targ is ~15, XLM-targ is ~13, mBERT-permute is ~9, and XLM-permute is ~9; for IE-Indic, mBERT-targ is ~5, XLM-targ is ~6, mBERT-permute is ~18, and XLM-permute is ~17; for IE-Romance, mBERT-targ is ~15, XLM-targ is ~13, mBERT-permute is ~3, and XLM-permute is ~3; for IE-Slavic, mBERT-targ is ~15, XLM-targ is ~13, mBERT-permute is ~10, and XLM-permute is ~10; for IE-other, mBERT-targ is ~15, XLM-targ is ~13, mBERT-permute is ~6, and XLM-permute is ~6; for Isolate, mBERT-targ is ~35, XLM-targ is ~25, mBERT-permute is ~2, and XLM-permute is ~2; for Semitic, mBERT-targ is ~10, XLM-targ is ~11, mBERT-permute is ~11, and XLM-permute is ~11; for Uralic, mBERT-targ is ~28, XLM-targ is ~21, mBERT-permute is ~1, and XLM-permute is ~1. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
